analysis:
Examined docs/architecture/inference.md BASE lines 2034–2597. Both units are unchanged surrounding documentation according to the complete range map, not evidence of new executable behavior. Reviewed native ownership and retirement, context/memory admission, media decoding, encrypted prefix reuse, cancellation, tool/schema validation, reasoning suppression/logprobs, usage accounting and encrypted coordinator streaming against the indexed threats. Relevant contracts include T-041 cache scoping/storage, T-050 diskless media, T-010 cancellation, T-007/T-027 artifact/output integrity, T-008 encrypted response failure and T-056 qualification limits. No independently supported regression appears in these units; documented defaults and qualification limitations are pre-existing.
Integration must reconcile the changes outside these units: HEAD 684–691 replaces separate GLM weight-hash passes with a verified manifest aggregate and permits restart registration from file-identity metadata. Verify GLM5NextManagedLoad.verifiedArtifactSHA256, ProviderLoop.verifiedGLM5NextWeightHash and VerifiedWeightHashStore preserve the A-004/T-012/T-027 artifact binding through construction and verify again before serving. HEAD 818–821 changes video presentation/timing semantics; review its decoder and admission changes together with the unchanged bounded media/ownership contracts described at BASE 2083–2096 and 2132–2180. The bounded patch is incomplete and implementation evidence is absent here, so these contracts remain unverified rather than findings. Nothing supplied establishes changes to authorization, attestation, token custody, fan authority or billing controls.
